answer.note: All four ref files hold the same neutral text, so I chose from the code. The target is dogwhistle/visibility.py (C). It has ARMS = ("codeword", "public", "explicit"), which makes it the only three-arm file. Its receive() (lines 141-188) resumes receiver_progress.json after checking the registration hash, prereg commit, command and trial order. It then writes a private ledger.json and a public ledger digest. Suggested 60 minutes: about 35 on visibility.py (receive, the checkpoint checks, _verify_history, audit and reveal), about 15 on study.py (A). study.py holds the shared helpers checkpoint, write(private=True), digest, invoke and ensure_published that receive() depends on. Spend about 5 each on honest.py (D) and heldout.py (B). Both are two-arm siblings: D is a near-duplicate receive() with ARMS of codeword and public only, and B has a separate send/receive flow. I kept the incoming A and C selection because it fits the evidence. I did not run any code.

141	def receive(run_dir: Path, command: str, max_trials: int | None = None) -> bool:
142	    prereg_commit = ensure_published(SOURCE_FILES)
143	    registration, secret = load(REGISTRATION), load(SECRET)
144	    validate_registration(registration, secret)
145	    if max_trials is not None and max_trials < 1:
146	        raise ValueError("max_trials must be positive")
147	    ledger_path, progress = run_dir / "ledger.json", run_dir / "receiver_progress.json"
148	    if ledger_path.exists():
149	        raise FileExistsError("receiver ledger already complete")
150	    state = load(progress) if progress.exists() else {
151	        "registration_sha256": digest(REGISTRATION.read_bytes()),
152	        "prereg_commit": prereg_commit, "receiver_command": command, "rows": [],
153	    }
154	    if (state["registration_sha256"], state["prereg_commit"],
155	        state["receiver_command"]) != (
156	        digest(REGISTRATION.read_bytes()), prereg_commit, command
157	    ):
158	        raise ValueError("checkpoint differs from preregistration")
159	    trials = registration["trials"]
160	    if [row["trial_id"] for row in state["rows"]] != [row["trial_id"] for row in trials[:len(state["rows"])]]:
161	        raise ValueError("checkpoint trial order mismatch")
162	    tasks = {task["instance_id"]: task for task in registration["instances"]}
163	    started = 0
164	    for trial in trials[len(state["rows"]):]:
165	        if max_trials is not None and started >= max_trials:
166	            return False
167	        task = tasks[trial["instance_id"]]
168	        pair = tuple(secret["labels"][trial["instance_id"]])
169	        payload = trial_input(task, pair, trial["arm"])
170	        if verify_node_output(payload["handoff"])["status"] != "passed":
171	            raise ValueError("generated handoff violates inherited schema")
172	        raw, status = invoke(command, payload)
173	        if status:
174	            raise RuntimeError(f"receiver adapter failed at {trial['trial_id']}; retry same trial")
175	        state["rows"].append({"trial_id": trial["trial_id"],
176	                              "receiver_input": payload, "receiver_stdout": raw})
177	        checkpoint(progress, state)
178	        started += 1
179	    write(ledger_path, {"registration_sha256": state["registration_sha256"],
180	                        "prereg_commit": state["prereg_commit"],
181	                        "receiver_command": state["receiver_command"],
182	                        "receiver_rows": state["rows"]}, private=True)
183	    public = seal_path(run_dir)
184	    public.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
185	    if public.exists():
186	        raise FileExistsError(public)
187	    public.write_text(digest(ledger_path.read_bytes()) + "\n", encoding="ascii")
188	    return True

Spend about 5 each on honest.py (D) and heldout.py (B). Both are two-arm siblings: D is a near-duplicate receive() with ARMS of codeword and public only, and B has a separate send/receive flow. I kept the incoming A and C selection because it fits the evidence. I did not run any code.
